grammar_definitions.verb: word expressing action state or process
grammar_definitions.adverb: word modifying verb adjective or adverb
grammar_definitions.conjunction: word connecting words phrases or clauses
grammar_definitions.subject: clause element about which predicate is asserted
grammar_definitions.predicate: clause element asserting something about subject
grammar_definitions.object: verb-related participant receiving or affected by action
grammar_definitions.modifier: element restricting or describing another element
grammar_definitions.head: central element determining phrase type
grammar_definitions.phrase: group of words functioning as unit
grammar_definitions.clause: unit containing predicate and typically subject
grammar_definitions.mood: grammatical expression of modality or attitude
grammar_definitions.voice: grammatical relation between action and participants
grammar_definitions.number: grammatical distinction such as singular and plural
grammar_definitions.plural: grammatical number for more than one
grammar_definitions.case: grammatical marking of syntactic or semantic role
grammar_definitions.declension: inflection of nouns pronouns or adjectives
grammar_definitions.modal: auxiliary expressing possibility necessity permission or related modality
grammar_definitions.copula: linking verb joining subject and complement
grammar_definitions.participle: verb form with verbal and adjectival functions
grammar_definitions.antecedent: expression to which another expression refers
grammar_definitions.independent clause: clause capable of standing as sentence
grammar_definitions.syntax: system governing combination of linguistic units
grammar_definitions.grammar: system of structural rules of language
grammar_definitions.coordination: joining elements of equal grammatical status
grammar_definitions.transitive: verb construction permitting or requiring object
grammar_definitions.reference: relation between expression and what it denotes
grammar_definitions.negation: grammatical denial or reversal of proposition
grammar_definitions.question: interrogative expression seeking information
grammar_definitions.proposition: meaning capable of being asserted or evaluated
